A thin cylindrical shell is $4\ \text{m}$ long and $1\ \text{m}$ in internal diameter. It is subjected to internal pressure of $1.5\ \text{MPa}$. If the thickness of the sheet is $10\ \text{mm}$, find the circumferential stress, longitudinal stress, changes in diameter, length and volume. Take $E=210\ \text{GPa}$ and $\mu=0.3$.

questions.markdown: A composite bar consists of an aluminum section rigidly fastened between a bronze section and a steel section as shown in figure. Axial loads are applied at the positions indicated. Determine the change in each section and the change in total length. Cross sectional area of steel, aluminum and bronze is $130\ \text{mm}^2$, $170\ \text{mm}^2$ and $150\ \text{mm}^2$ respectively.

questions.markdown: A bar of certain material $40\ \text{mm} \times 40\ \text{mm}$ in cross section is subjected to an axial pull of $100\ \text{kN}$. The extension over a length of $110\ \text{mm}$ is $0.05\ \text{mm}$ and decrease in each side is $0.005\ \text{mm}$. Calculate (i) $E$ (ii) $\mu$ (iii) $G$ (iv) $K$.

A mild steel rod $6\ \text{mm}$ diameter passes centrally through a copper tube of internal diameter $20\ \text{mm}$ and thickness $5\ \text{mm}$. The composite section is $500\ \text{mm}$ long and their ends are rigidly connected. It is then acted upon by an axial tensile load of $60\ \text{kN}$. Find the stresses & deformation in steel and copper. Take $E_{cu} = 100\ \text{GPa}$, $E_s = 200\ \text{GPa}$.
